prompt: A rectangular box has length $\frac{1}{2}$ ft, width $\frac{1}{2}$ ft, and height $\frac{1}{2}$ ft. What is its **volume** in cubic feet?
hint: Volume $= l \times w \times h$. Multiply three fractions by multiplying numerators and denominators.

alternativeExplanations.title: As $\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^3$
steps: Same value all three sides means $\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^3$.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Try a similar but smaller shape (all sides ÷ 2) and look at how the formula behaves.
